cleaner.label: vcpkg cache
cleaner.description: Binary packages, intermediate build files and sources downloaded by vcpkg. Does not touch installed packages.

option.label: vcpkg binary cache
option.description: Removes the archives of already-built packages. On the next install vcpkg rebuilds them from source.
option.warning: Packages are rebuilt on the next `vcpkg install`: it can take a long time.

option.label: Intermediate build files (buildtrees)
option.description: Removes extracted sources, objects and logs of the builds done by vcpkg.

option.label: Packages in staging (packages)
option.description: Removes the files vcpkg sets aside before the final installation.

option.label: Downloaded tools and sources
option.description: Removes the tools and source archives downloaded by vcpkg.
option.warning: Tools and sources are re-downloaded on the next `vcpkg install`: network required.
